description: Source code for the 'Analyzer' class in the 'gn' build system, responsible for analyzing build dependencies and affected targets based on input JSON data.

classes.name: Analyzer
classes.description: Class responsible for analyzing build dependencies and affected targets based on input JSON data.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Main method that processes input JSON string to determine affected build targets and dependencies.

methods.name: GetAllAffectedItems
methods.description: Returns all items directly or indirectly affected by changes in source files.

methods.name: InvalidLabels
methods.description: Filters out invalid labels not corresponding to known build items.

methods.name: TargetsFor
methods.description: Converts a set of labels into a set of build targets.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a set of targets to exclude groups, only including individual build targets.

methods.name: FilterTarget
methods.description: Recursively filters a target and its dependencies.

methods.name: ItemRefersToFile
methods.description: Checks if a build item refers to a specific source file.

methods.name: AddItemsDirectlyReferringToFile
methods.description: Adds items that directly refer to a given source file.

methods.name: AddAllItemsReferringToItem
methods.description: Recursively adds all items referring to a specific item.

methods.name: WereMainGNFilesModified
methods.description: Checks if main GN files or dependencies have been modified.
